method: Levelling measurements and Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) context
periodContext: Reported as settlement over approximately a ten-year period associated with harbour infrastructure built in 1995; see original paper for study methodology.

publication.title: The Identification of Land Subsidance by Levelling Measurement and GPR Data at Tanjung Emas Harbour, Semarang

limitations: Historic study reports sector-level measurements, not modern GNSS observation records.
These ranges are historical cumulative quantities, not annual subsidence rates and not 2026 asset conditions.
No survey-quality coordinates for individual measured sectors are supplied in this MVP. Do not map sector locations as exact points.
Not linked to CSEM GPS time series or BAKO multi-GNSS QC as a common geodetic solution.
Not engineering thresholds, structural safety judgements or current inspection priorities.
